$MAX = 100005;
$MAX2 = 1000000000000000010; // 1e18 + 10

$dp = array_fill(0, $MAX, 0);
$dp[0] = strlen($f0);

$len_s1 = strlen($s1);
$len_s2 = strlen($s2);
$sum_s = $len_s0 + $len_s1 + $len_s2;

for ($i = 1; $i < $MAX; $i++) {
    if ($dp[$i - 1] > $MAX2 / 2) {
        $dp[$i] = $MAX2;
    } else {
        $dp[$i] = $dp[$i - 1] * 2 + $sum_s;
    }
}

$tokens = [];
$token_idx = 0;

function nextToken() {
    global $tokens, $token_idx;
    while (true) {
        if ($token_idx < count($tokens)) {
            return $tokens[$token_idx++];
        }
        $line = fgets(STDIN);
        if ($line === false) return null;
        $line = trim($line);
        if ($line === '') continue;
        $tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $line);
        $token_idx = 0;
    }
}

function nextInt() { return (int)nextToken(); }
function nextLong() { return (int)nextToken(); }

$N = nextInt();
$res = '';

for ($q = 0; $q < $N; $q++) {
    $a = nextInt();
    $b = nextLong() - 1;
    $c = '.';

    while ($a != -1) {
        if ($b >= $dp[$a]) {
            $c = '.';
            break;
        }
        if ($a == 0) {
            $c = $f0[$b];
            break;
        }
        if ($b < $len_s0) {
            $c = $s0[$b];
            break;
        }
        $b -= $len_s0;
        if ($b < $dp[$a - 1]) {
            $a--;
            continue;
        }
        $b -= $dp[$a - 1];
        if ($b < $len_s1) {
            $c = $s1[$b];
            break;
        }
        $b -= $len_s1;
        if ($b < $dp[$a - 1]) {
            $a--;
            continue;
        }
        $b -= $dp[$a - 1];
        $c = $s2[$b];
        break;
    }
    $res .= $c;
}

echo $res . "\n";
